faq.q: Is Subway Surfers safe for kids?
faq.a: Yes. Subway Surfers is rated Everyone and has no chat with strangers. It shows ads and sells optional coins and keys, so turn on Google Play's purchase authentication for young children.

faq.q: Why is Subway Surfers so laggy?
faq.a: Close other apps, lower the graphics quality in settings if available, free up storage and restart the phone. Updating to the latest version also fixes many performance problems.

faq.q: Why is Subway Surfers not updating?
faq.a: Check that Google Play auto-update is on and that you have enough free storage. Then open the Play listing and tap Update.

faq.q: Subway Surfers vs Temple Run: which is better?
faq.a: Subway Surfers has a new season every few weeks with new cities, characters and boards. Temple Run 2 is a classic endless runner with simpler, quicker runs.
